save_object_pickle: save a Python object to disk by pickling it to a specified file path
cache_url_download: download a remote URL to a local cache directory and return the cached file path
download_url_with_progress: download a URL to a destination file with a configurable progress bar hook
assert_cache_file_md5: verify a cached file matches its reference MD5 hash from the URL
get_file_md5sum: compute and return the MD5 hash digest of a given file
